extraction.Name: Frank McClosky
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 12, 1918 by the Security Bank
extraction.Buyer: McClosky and his wife conveyed the south half of the southwest quarter of section 8 and the north half of the northwest quarter of section 20, township 98, range 78, to W. H. Tackett for $13,500
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612723 issued; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 12, 1918; deed dated May 23, 1921; land was mortgaged February 28, 1918 for $500.00, March 20, 1918 for $5,000, June 16, 1919 for $1,500.00, and June 24, 1920 for $350.00; mortgages have apparently been released; allottee has a wife
